name: ntfy
description: Push notifications to your phone via ntfy — connector library + agent skill. No account, one topic name.
env_example: # Topic = the channel. Pick something UNGUESSABLE: anyone who knows
# the topic name can read and post to it. e.g. alert-marek-8f3a1c.
# Self-hosted server? Change this. Public default needs no setup.
# Only for protected topics on private servers:
post_install: Pick a topic name (unguessable!) and set NTFY_TOPIC in .env.
Install the ntfy app on your phone and subscribe to the SAME topic.
Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform.
